The Chinese characters for Anthony

As a transliteration, Anthony is usually written 安东尼 (Ān dōng ní). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

With Latin origins, Anthony is usually read as “priceless one (from the Roman name Antonius)”.

About the name Anthony

Saint Anthony of Padua made the name beloved in the Christian world.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Anthony suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
